ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block; 5 page marker(s) preserved in place; attributions: L. Tolstoy.
Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (register, omissions, glosses, attribution form).

Tolstoy's chain of repetitions is kept («всё ослабевало и ослабевало», 'grew weaker and weaker'; «бедственность, непрочность и бессмысленность», 'misery, precariousness, and meaninglessness', twice). «Начало» (nachalo) is 'principle'; «разумное сознание» (razumnoe soznanie) is 'rational consciousness' throughout.
